name: CodexBar Usage
author: xli
description: Show CodexBar-reported remaining quota for any provider on your Flexbar

Usage.Title: Usage Key
Usage.Tip: Remaining quota for one CodexBar provider. Click to refresh.

Config.IntervalHint: Applies to every provider immediately. 120 by default.
Config.PathHint: Leave empty to auto-detect (Homebrew paths, then PATH).
Config.ProviderHint: Any provider id accepted by `codexbar usage --provider`.
Config.Note: All data comes from the local CodexBar CLI. The plugin never talks to providers itself.

Usage.Title: 用量按键
Usage.Tip: 显示一家 CodexBar 服务商的剩余配额，点击立即刷新。

Config.IntervalHint: 保存后立即对所有服务商生效，默认 120。
Config.PathHint: 留空则自动查找（Homebrew 路径，然后 PATH）。
Config.ProviderHint: codexbar usage --provider 支持的任意 id。
Config.Note: 所有数据来自本机 CodexBar CLI，插件自身不访问任何服务商。
